legenda_completa: Grand Theft Auto VI’s PlayStation 5 home screen music has surfaced as pre-loads begin rolling out around the world. The track is a gentle, 1980s-style synth instrumental with no vocals, and it plays while Grand Theft Auto VI is highlighted on the PlayStation 5 dashboard. Players in New Zealand, where the pre-load opened first, were among the first to record and share it, and clips of the music spread quickly from there. The game’s PlayStation page, shown in this clip, carries the PS5, PS5 Pro Enhanced and Ultimate Edition tags, with the launch countdown sitting at nine days and 14 hours when the recording was made.
